note: Where the browser loads the Pyodide runtime from. "vendored" serves it from this origin (app/static/pyodide/, ~12 MB, fetched by scripts/vendor_pyodide.py); nothing touches the network and the site works fully offline. "cdn" skips vendoring entirely: the deploy carries no runtime, but the site then needs the network on every load and you are trusting a third party to serve code that executes in the page. `version` is the single source of truth — scripts/vendor_pyodide.py reads it, and {version} is substituted into `cdn` — so the two can never drift apart.
